name: claude-in-chrome-cli
description: Call Claude in Chrome MCP tools from the shell. Drives your real, logged-in Chrome from scripts, cron jobs, and agents that cannot hold an MCP connection.

scripts.test: node test/test_tabs_parser.js && sh test/test_tabs_mcp.sh && node test/test_cic_cli.js

c8.//: The tests drive both programs as child processes, which c8 follows via NODE_V8_COVERAGE. all:true counts files the suite never loads rather than hiding them. The floors are the 0.4.0 baseline rounded down, so they catch a regression without failing on a one-line move; they are not aspirations.
